source: OEM Technical Service Information & Diagnostic Manuals

codes.description: Air/Fuel Ratio Sensor Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
causes: Defective A/F sensor (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
Exhaust manifold leak ahead of sensor
Sensor harness open/short
ECM fuel calculation error

codes.system: Fuel & Air Metering (Air/Fuel Ratio Sensor Heater)
codes.description: Air/Fuel Ratio Sensor Heater Circuit Response (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
symptoms: Delayed closed loop fuel trim entry
causes: Blown A/F heater element (normal cold resistance 0.8-1.4 ohms)
Blown EFI or A/F heater fuse/relay
Wiring corrosion at sensor sub-harness

codes.description: Air/Fuel Ratio Sensor Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 2 Sensor 1)
causes: Faulty Bank 2 Sensor 1 A/F sensor
Bank 2 exhaust manifold gasket leak
Intake manifold vacuum leak on Bank 2

codes.system: Fuel & Air Metering (Air/Fuel Ratio Sensor Heater)
codes.description: Air/Fuel Ratio Sensor Heater Circuit Response (Bank 2 Sensor 1)
causes: Open heater coil in Bank 2 Sensor 1
High resistance in power ground harness

codes.description: Igniter Circuit Malfunction (Cylinder No. 1 / IGF Confirmation Missing)
symptoms: Engine stalls or runs extremely rough
causes: Defective ignition coil with integrated igniter
Open or short in IGF feedback wire to ECM
Poor engine block ground

codes.description: Crankshaft Position Sensor Circuit (No CKP Signal While Engine Running)
causes: Damaged CKP sensor tip or reluctor ring teeth
Defective CKP sensor harness routing near exhaust
ECM internal pulse receiver failure

codes.description: VVT System Malfunction (Bank 1 Camshaft Phase Angle Deviation)
symptoms: Stalling when stopping at red lights
causes: Clogged VVT oil control valve (OCV) micro-screen filter
Stuck or failing VVT solenoid actuator
Low engine oil level or severely sludged oil
Worn VVT cam gear actuator

codes.description: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve Stuck Open (Bank 1)
symptoms: Air pump vacuum noise on deceleration
causes: Air switching valve stuck due to moisture/carbon accumulation
Air injection pump driver failure

codes.description: ECM BATT Backup Power Supply Circuit Malfunction
symptoms: Loss of radio presets / trip data
Loss of learned fuel trims after key-off
causes: Blown EFI backup fuse in underhood fuse box
Corroded constant +12V unswitched battery wire to ECM pin BATT

codes.description: Engine Control System Malfunction (ABS / VSC System Disabled)
symptoms: VSC OFF and TRAC OFF warning lights illuminated alongside Check Engine Light
ABS operational but traction control disabled
causes: Powertrain ECM has stored an active emission/engine trouble code and commanded Skid Control ECU to disable traction interventions
Note: Clear engine DTC first to resolve C1201

codes.description: Low Battery Positive Voltage or Abnormally High Power Supply
symptoms: Brake and ABS warning lights flicker
causes: Weak 12V auxiliary battery
Alternator diode ripple or voltage regulator fault
Corroded chassis ground strap

codes.description: Airbag Sensor Assembly Malfunction
symptoms: SRS / Airbag warning indicator on cluster illuminated
causes: Internal center airbag sensor assembly fault
Loose center console harness connector
Low system operating voltage during deployment check

codes.description: VTEC System Malfunction (Oil Pressure Switch or Spool Valve Circuit)
symptoms: Hard rev-limiter kick at 3,500 - 4,000 RPM (Limp mode)
causes: Critically low engine oil level or low oil pressure
Clogged VTEC spool valve solenoid mesh screen gasket
Defective VTEC oil pressure switch
Open wiring in VTEC solenoid circuit

codes.description: Electric Load Detector (ELD) Circuit High Voltage
symptoms: Alternator intermittently failing to charge battery
causes: Failed ELD module inside under-hood fuse/relay box
Open ELD ground circuit
ECM ELD input pin fault

codes.description: Random Cylinder Misfire Detected (Honda OEM Intermediate Code)
causes: Tight exhaust valve lash (valve adjustment required)
Clogged EGR manifold runners on intake manifold
Worn spark plugs or failing ignition coil packs
Partially clogged fuel injector

codes.description: EVAP Emission Control System Leak Detected (Fuel Tank System Area)
causes: Loose or worn fuel filler cap gasket
Damaged fuel tank neck
Failing two-way bypass valve
Fuel tank pressure (FTP) sensor defect

codes.description: EVAP Emission Control System Leak Detected (EVAP Canister Area)
causes: Corroded EVAP canister vent shut valve (CVS) solenoid caused by road salt
Rusted CVS mounting screw puncturing canister plastic
Cracked vacuum lines near charcoal canister

codes.description: EGR Valve Lift Insufficient Detected
causes: Defective EGR valve lift sensor
Carbon-locked EGR pintle valve
Damaged wiring to 5-pin EGR connector

codes.description: Transmission Range Switch (Short to Ground / Shift Position Mismatch)
symptoms: D indicator light on dash flashing
Inability to shift out of park without override
causes: Corroded or misadjusted neutral safety / range switch on transmission housing
Water intrusion in range switch harness

codes.description: 2nd Clutch Transmission Fluid Pressure Switch Circuit Malfunction
symptoms: Delayed or slipping shift into 2nd gear
causes: Defective 2nd clutch oil pressure switch (located on transmission casing)
Restricted fluid passages
Burnt ATF fluid

codes.description: ABS Modulator Control Unit Low Battery Voltage
symptoms: ABS and BRAKE warning lights come on together
causes: Battery voltage dropped below 9.5V during starter cranking
Failing starter drawing excessive current
Corroded main battery ground cable

gm.name: General Motors
gm.protocols: GMLAN (SWCAN 33.3k Pin 1), SAE J1850 VPW (Pin 2), ISO 15765-4 (CAN 500k)

codes.description: Throttle Position (TP) Sensor 1 Circuit Out of Range
symptoms: Reduced Engine Power message displayed on Driver Information Center
causes: Worn TPS potentiometer track inside throttle body
Corroded 5V reference wire in engine harness
Throttle actuator control (TAC) motor failure

codes.description: Heated Oxygen Sensor (HO2S) Insufficient Switching Bank 1 Sensor 1
causes: Aged or silicon-contaminated HO2S sensor
Exhaust manifold crack (very common on GM Vortec engines)
Low fuel pressure

codes.description: Fuel System Lean During Rapid Acceleration
symptoms: Engine stumble/bog when pressing accelerator pedal firmly
causes: Weak in-tank fuel pump unable to maintain volume
Clogged fuel filter
Contaminated MAF hot-film sensor

codes.description: Engine Coolant Overtemperature Above 268°F - Protection Mode Active
symptoms: Engine enters alternate-cylinder air pumping mode
causes: Stuck-closed thermostat
Blown head gasket
Failed water pump impeller
Cooling fan relay failure

codes.description: EGR Valve Closed Position Performance (Pintle Not Fully Seated)
causes: Hard carbon chunk lodged underneath EGR pintle valve seat
Defective pintle position potentiometer
Weak return spring

codes.description: EVAP System Flow During Non-Purge (Purge Solenoid Stuck Open)
symptoms: Long crank time immediately after filling gas tank at station
causes: Charcoal granules from failed EVAP canister sucked into purge valve holding it open
Defective EVAP purge solenoid
Vacuum hose routed incorrectly

codes.description: Throttle Actuator Control (TAC) Module Position Performance
causes: Throttle blade binding from heavy varnish/carbon build-up
Broken TAC harness wire near alternator bracket
Defective electronic throttle body assembly

codes.description: Theft Deterrent Fuel Enable Signal Not Received (Passlock / VATS)
symptoms: Engine cranks, fires for 2 seconds, and immediately dies; Security indicator flashing
causes: Worn ignition lock cylinder Passlock sensor
Faulty Body Control Module (BCM)
Lost communication on Class 2 Serial Data line

codes.description: Transmission Component Slipping (TCC Converter Slip Speed Exceeded)
symptoms: Harsh 1-2 upshift when transmission warms up to operating temperature
causes: Worn TCC regulator valve bore inside aluminum valve body causing converter clutch slip
Glazed torque converter lockup clutch
Worn 2-4 servo band

codes.description: Class 2 Communication Malfunction (Condition for Setting Comm DTC)
causes: Corroded Splice Pack (SP205 / SP208) comb connector under dash
Water intrusion in driver seat module or trailer module pulling Class 2 bus to ground

ford.name: Ford Motor Company
ford.protocols: MS-CAN (125k Pins 3 & 11), SAE J1850 PWM (Pins 2 & 10), ISO 15765-4 (CAN 500k)

codes.description: OBD-II Monitor Testing Incomplete (Drive Cycle Needed)
symptoms: Vehicle will fail state emissions inspection; no drivability issues
causes: Battery was recently disconnected or trouble codes were recently cleared
Drive cycle requirements have not all been satisfied (EVAP and Cat monitors take specific driving conditions to run)

codes.description: Lack of Upstream Heated Oxygen Sensor Switch - Sensor Indicates Lean (Bank 1)
causes: Intake manifold runner control (IMRC) gasket leak
Cracked PCV rubber elbow hose (common behind intake)
Dirty MAF sensor

codes.description: Lack of Upstream Heated Oxygen Sensor Switch - Sensor Indicates Lean (Bank 2)
causes: Bank 2 vacuum leak
Weak fuel pump pressure
Exhaust header crack

codes.description: THEFT Detected, Vehicle Immobilized (Passive Anti-Theft System Active)
symptoms: Rapidly flashing THEFT light on instrument cluster
Engine cranks but will not start
causes: Unprogrammed RFID transponder ignition key
Defective PATS transceiver antenna ring on steering column
PATS-PCM handshake security key synchronization lost

codes.description: Cylinder Head Temperature (CHT) Sensor Out of Self-Test Range
symptoms: Temperature gauge pegged on cold start
Radiator high-speed fans roaring on start
causes: Defective dry-well CHT sensor (screwed into cylinder head metal, does not touch coolant)
Wiring harness chewed by rodents under intake manifold

codes.description: Unable to Bleed Up Bleed Fuel Tank Vacuum (EVAP Purge Valve Stuck)
symptoms: Whistling noise from fuel cap area
Fuel tank sides collapsing inward under extreme manifold vacuum
Engine stalling at stoplights after refuel
causes: Under-hood EVAP purge solenoid stuck open drawing continuous vacuum into fuel tank
Blocked EVAP canister vent solenoid

codes.description: Keep Alive Memory (KAM) Voltage Too Low
symptoms: Vehicle runs rough for 10 miles after every restart
causes: Blown KAM / PCM unswitched power fuse in battery junction box
Corroded PCM power diode in fuse box

codes.description: Torque Converter Clutch (TCC) System Mechanically Stuck In Off Position
symptoms: Engine RPM does not drop on highway when cruising above 50 MPH
causes: Worn torque converter internal clutch lining
Damaged TCC solenoid valve
Cracked transmission pump stator support shaft seal

codes.description: CAN Communication Bus Fault - Receive Error (Instrument Cluster / ABS / PCM)
symptoms: ABS and Brake lights flash on bumps
causes: Cracked solder joints on the main wiring connector on the back of the instrument cluster circuit board
Corroded ABS module pin connector
Intermittent CAN-H or CAN-L open circuit
